headline: Islanders’ Stanley fined for slashing Devils’ Hischier
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the NHL fined Islanders defenseman Logan Stanley for slashing Nico Hischier, after he delivered several whacks on the Devils center during New Jersey's 5-4 overtime win Saturday.

The two players involved tell you something about the night. Hischier is the engine of a 12-5-0 Devils team: New Jersey takes 62.6% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, about five points better than without him, and his 7 goals are right in line with his chances.

Stanley is in his first season on Long Island after playing for Winnipeg last year, averaging 21 minutes a night with 5 assists and no goals. The Islanders have been better with him on the ice, though they've also scored about 4.9 more goals than their chances deserve while he plays. Expect Hischier to see a lot more of him; these teams are in the same division.
